_doc: Atlas layout. Owner: Animations. One source for the Godot bake (tools/bake), the phone bake (src/render/commander_bake.js), the sprite player (src/render/units.js) and tools/timing_check.mjs. Columns are frames in clip order; rows are the baked directions.
_cell_doc: footY: the ground line inside the cell. bodyPx: target height of an upright guard pose, leaving headroom for raised arms.
_directions_doc: Six headings from three rows: the player mirrors each row horizontally for the opposite side. yawDeg turns the model away from facing the camera (0 = facing the camera, -90 = facing screen right).
_camera_doc: pitchDeg measured from prototype/raid.html: camera height 1.12 x near distance, so 48 deg to the near row and 40 deg to the far row; 44 is the middle. Arena owns the board camera and is asked to confirm.

budget._doc: Decoded memory, RGBA 4 bytes per pixel. Checked by tools/timing_check.mjs.
